title: Device onboarding manifest (Phase F.4)
description: Declarative spec for one device's wg-cp0 bundle. Consumed by `goat admin client onboard <handle>`, which translates the manifest into a bundle-create invocation. Per-site fleet config (CA-id, age-identity / piv-slot, trust-anchor path, snitch-collector) is NOT in this manifest — it's resolved from env vars + CLI flags by the wrapper. See docs/design/goat-cli.md §Phase F.4.

handle.description: Kebab-case slug; filename = ops/devices/<handle>.yml. 3-32 chars, no leading/trailing hyphen.

role.description: Device role tag — informational for the operator + cross-referenced by the wrapper when deriving sensible default ACL groups. Authoritative ACL membership comes from bundle.acl_groups.

added.description: ISO 8601 date the device was first onboarded (YYYY-MM-DD).

added_by.description: Email of the operator who minted this device's first bundle.

notes.description: Free-form notes — hardware model, physical location, intended use.

device_id.description: Device identifier passed to bundle-create -device-id (e.g. mgmt-prov-site3-01-orin, op-laptop). Convention: <role>-<site>-<n>-<form-factor> or <role>-<host>.

site.description: Site identifier passed to bundle-create -site (e.g. vega, nova, prov-rla).

peer_pubkey.description: Optional base64 32-byte mesh peer pubkey. If absent, bundle-create generates a placeholder per Block 21/22H forward-compat.

acl_groups.description: Uppercase ACL group names passed to bundle-create -acl-groups (joined comma-separated). Common shapes: ['VEGA','VEGA-MGMT'] for site-scoped, ['NOVA','NOVA-OPERATOR'] for operator devices.

ttl_days.description: Bundle TTL in days. Cert / setup-key expiry is derived from this.

activation_days.description: Bundle activation deadline in days from mint (per ADR 0308 §3.1).

mesh_route_subnet.description: Optional comma-separated CIDRs added to every relay's AllowedIPs (-mesh-route-subnet). Use for mgmt-host Orins that consume via wg-cp0-bundle-apply across multiple relays — see F-114.

snitch.description: When true, mint a snitch_probe_key + embed it in the bundle (Block 61). Wrapper additionally reads $SNITCH_ADMIN_KEY + --snitch-collector to register the key automatically.
